title: LEMON — Difficult Airway Assessment
sources: Reed MJ et al. Emerg Med J 2005
purpose: Fast pre-intubation difficult-airway checklist when there is no time for a full workup. No single validated cutoff — a higher score plus clinical gestalt predicts a harder intubation.

items.label: Look externally — facial trauma, large incisors, beard, large tongue, abnormal facies
Evaluate 3-3-2 — mouth opening < 3 fingerbreadths / hyoid-to-chin < 3 / thyroid notch-to-mouth-floor < 2

interpretation.label: No LEMON features flagged
interpretation.detail: Still apply clinical gestalt and have a backup plan ready.

interpretation.label: Some difficult-airway features present
interpretation.detail: Optimise positioning and pre-oxygenation; have video laryngoscopy, bougie, and a supraglottic rescue ready.

interpretation.label: Multiple difficult-airway features
interpretation.detail: Strongly consider the most experienced operator, video laryngoscopy first pass, a double set-up for a surgical airway, and a delayed-sequence or awake approach if the situation allows.

buildNote: Orchestrated by the Airway Management Flow procedure. There is no validated numeric threshold — the bands here are pragmatic UI guidance, not a published cutoff.
